source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
**HERETIC ASTARTES** models in your army lose [Dark Pacts](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts), and their ranged weapons have **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)**. When mustering, you can't use the [Cults of the Dark Gods](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.cults-of-the-dark-gods) rule.

**Vendetta**: as your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins, pick 1 enemy unit as your Vendetta target until your next Command phase begins. **HERETIC ASTARTES** models of yours, except **DAMNED** models, may re-roll **Hit rolls** for attacks against that target.

**Twisted Doctrine**: in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), whenever you set up a **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit of yours that isn't **Battle-shocked**, or pick one to move, it may Default to Doctrine. Doing so means first taking a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock), then picking 1 effect for the rest of the turn:

- [Falling Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) doesn't stop it from shooting or declaring a charge this turn.
- [Advancing](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) doesn't stop it from declaring a charge this turn.
